title: Salzburg and Münster books and German-speaking diocesan Mass propers

traditions.label: Salzburg local Mass books
traditions.scope: The 1605 Salzburg missal and later local Mass-proper printings, with the Roman basis and particular feasts kept distinct.
traditions.coverage_note: The 1596 papal permission is reported by an archive museum; its original instrument, the 1605 body and exact replacement of preceding Salzburg texts remain to be checked.

traditions.label: Münster diocesan missal
traditions.scope: The 1632 Münster missal and a bound 1784 supplement expressly addressed to it.
traditions.coverage_note: Original 1632 decree and the 1784 supplement text remain unread; the indexed book states do not establish a complete revision sequence.

traditions.label: German-speaking Swiss diocesan propers
traditions.scope: German local Mass and lectionary supplements to the postconciliar Roman books.
traditions.coverage_note: St Gall identifies the 1976 volumes as current official local Mass texts; the original volumes and approval leaves have not been inspected.

traditions.label: Cologne postconciliar propers
traditions.scope: Latin and German particular Mass and lectionary components of the Roman books for the Archdiocese of Cologne.
traditions.coverage_note: The 2026 official directorium calls the 2002 components binding; original 2002 approval and book pages remain uninspected.

traditions.label: Speyer postconciliar propers
traditions.scope: Particular calendar, Mass propers and lectionary components for the Diocese of Speyer.
traditions.coverage_note: The 2023 lectionary reports separate 1971, 1972 and 1975 authority events; original instruments and the first proper book are not inspected.

sources.title: DomQuartier Salzburg, Die geistliche Musik an der Bischofskirche
sources.inspection: HTML section Wolf Dietrich räumt auf read 2026-10-20; archive object caption and paragraphs on 1596 permission, 1605 printing, Roman basis and local feasts checked.
sources.limitations: Institutional retrospective and object caption, not the original 1596 instrument or complete 1605 missal. No original book-body collation or first-use date.

sources.title: Missae Propriae cum propriis Sanctorum Archidioecesis Salisburgensis Officiis (1642), catalogue
sources.inspection: Catalogue title, 1642 date and 14-page extent read 2026-10-20; book pages not collated.
sources.limitations: Bibliographic entry alone cannot establish which formularies differ from the 1605 book or whether and where the booklet was used.

sources.title: Usuarium 6490, Missale Monasteriense (1632)
sources.inspection: Record title, date, shelfmark and contents index read 2026-10-20; original title and decree are indexed at images 7 and 11, but neither image text was transcribed.
sources.limitations: Title claims Roman ceremonial accommodation and added saint offices; original 1632 decree and before/after Missal content remain uncollated. Usuarium remarks that the book represents the medieval use despite its title.

sources.title: Bistumsarchiv Münster, Findbuch der Handschriften und Druckschriften der Pfarrarchive
sources.inspection: PDF pp.37–38, DS 0212 and DS 1915–17 read 2026-10-20; title and 1784 supplement title/extent indexed there.
sources.limitations: An archive finding aid, not an image or transcription of the complete supplement; copy differences and individual directives require checking.

sources.title: Diocese of St Gall, Bistumsheilige and official local liturgical texts
sources.inspection: Official diocesan page section Die offiziellen Texte für die liturgischen Feiern read 2026-10-20; it names 1976 Missal and Lectionary supplements and current local downloads.
sources.limitations: Current use is attested by diocesan direction; the 1976 first publication, its approval leaves and exact texts have not been independently checked.

sources.title: Archdiocese of Cologne, Directorium 2026, valid liturgical books
sources.inspection: PDF p.26, printed XXVIII, items h and m (continuing p.27) read 2026-10-20; particular Mass book and Lectionary are listed as binding.
sources.limitations: 2026 book list reports a 2002 publication and current binding status, not the original 2002 decree, its effective date or the exact prayers.

sources.title: Diocese of Speyer, Messlektionar: Die Eigenfeiern des Bistums Speyer (2023)
sources.inspection: Official 44-page lectionary PDF p.0 title, p.2 Approbation und Konfirmation, p.4 contents read 2026-10-20; date/protocol references and sample feast ranks checked.
sources.limitations: 1971–1975 events are reported in a 2023 book, not original decree images. This is a lectionary, not an acquired copy of the companion second expanded 2023 Mass proper.

sources.title: Diocese of Speyer, Eigenfeiern operative-book page
sources.inspection: Official diocesan page checked 2026-10-20; 2023 Missal second expanded edition and Lectionary first edition identified.
sources.limitations: Page does not provide a collation of the second Missal edition against the first or original first-edition approval leaves.

stages.label: Missale Salisburgense, Roman basis with Salzburg feasts
stages.scope: Salzburg missal as a local edition with Roman basis and particular feasts, according to an archive museum account.
stages.witness_label: Archive of the Archdiocese of Salzburg copy pictured by DomQuartier
stages.summary: Wolf Dietrich printed and distributed 1,228 copies. The institutional account identifies the Roman Missal as basis and says Salzburg local feasts were added. It separately reports Clement VIII's 1596 permission.

evidence.locus: Wolf Dietrich räumt auf, archive-object caption and paragraphs following it
evidence.claim: The institution identifies the 1605 book, reports its circulation, Roman basis, local feasts and earlier papal permission.

stages.limitations: The original 1596 act and full 1605 text are uninspected. Neither title nor retrospective description proves exact prayer changes or a direct descent from a particular Roman edition.
stages.reception: Reported publication and circulation in Salzburg, not a measured date of first or universal use.

stages.label: Salzburg proper Masses with saints' offices
stages.scope: Identified local proper booklet component, not a complete Missal replacement.
stages.witness_label: 1642 Salzburg proper booklet in Austrian National Library catalogue
stages.summary: The catalogue identifies a short printing of Salzburg saints' Mass propers with companion offices under archiepiscopal authority stated in its title.

evidence.claim: A particular Mass-proper booklet was printed in 1642.

stages.limitations: Original title image, formularies and relationship to the 1605 missal have not been collated; the title claim of authority is not an inspected decree.
stages.reception: Printing is identified; actual diocesan use remains unverified.

stages.label: Missale sanctae Monasteriensis ecclesiae
stages.scope: Identified Münster diocesan Missal whose title claims accommodation to Roman ceremonial and added saint offices.
stages.witness_label: ULB Münster 51 FOL 13-1_2, as indexed in Usuarium 6490
stages.summary: The indexed title attributes the book to Bishop Ferdinand's command and describes Roman ceremonial accommodation and additional saints' offices; the index locates a decree, general rubrics, calendar, Ordinary and Canon.

evidence.claim: The title and contents identify a 1632 Münster Missal and its claimed component scope.
Diocesan archive lists the 1632 Moretus printing in parish copies.

stages.limitations: Title claims are uncollated against an earlier Münster Missal or Roman edition; original bishop's decree remains unread. The Usuarium classification retains the medieval use despite the Romanizing title.
stages.reception: Parish copies are catalogued, including a 1673 donation inscription in DS 0212; no first-use or complete diocesan adoption date is asserted.

stages.label: Supplementum Missalis Monasteriensis for the 1632 Missal
stages.scope: Bound diocesan supplement giving observances after the correction of the Münster Breviary, expressly for the 1632 Missal.
stages.witness_label: Supplement in Münster diocesan archive copy DS 1915, printed pp.603–630
stages.summary: The archive catalogue transcribes a supplement title that attributes the 1784 correction to Bishop Maximilian Friedrich and directs subsequent observances for the Missal of 1632.

evidence.locus: PDF p.38, DS 1915–17, supplement title and pp.603–630
evidence.claim: The bounded supplement is addressed to the 1632 Missal and indexed in several copies.

stages.limitations: The 1784 pages are not read; exact Mass formularies and directions cannot be specified, and no whole new Missal or substantive transition is inferred.
stages.reception: Several archived parish copies contain the supplement; this does not establish a first-use date or uniform diocesan application.

stages.label: Diözesanproprien der deutschsprachigen Schweiz
stages.date_label: 1976 Missal and Lectionary supplements named in current diocesan list
stages.scope: German local propers and readings as adjuncts to the Roman Missal and Lectionary for German-speaking Swiss dioceses.
stages.witness_label: 1976 Einsiedeln Missal supplement and companion Lectionary cited by Diocese of St Gall
stages.summary: The diocese names the 1976 Missal supplement as the source of official Mass texts for saints in its diocesan calendar and lists a companion Lectionary supplement.

evidence.locus: Die offiziellen Texte für die liturgischen Feiern section
evidence.claim: The diocese directs readers to the 1976 Mass and Lectionary proper volumes for official local texts.

stages.limitations: The original 1976 books, approval leaves and individual feasts are uncollated; St Gall's present guidance does not certify identical reception by every German-speaking Swiss diocese in 1976.
stages.reception: Current St Gall official-use direction is attested; initial and wider reception dates are not.

stages.label: Eigenfeiern des Erzbistums Köln
stages.scope: Latin/German particular Mass propers and matching Lectionary component of the Roman books for Cologne.
stages.witness_label: 2002 Cologne proper Missal and Lectionary named in Directorium 2026
stages.summary: The official directorium lists the 2002 Latin/German Mass-proper book as a binding part of the archdiocesan Missal and the 2002 Lectionary proper as a binding Lectionary component.

evidence.locus: PDF p.26, printed XXVIII, item h; p.27 item m
evidence.claim: The 2026 authority list identifies the 2002 proper components and their binding diocesan status.

stages.limitations: The original 2002 books, approval instruments, exact prayers and effective date are not inspected. This is a local component state, not a distinct whole Order of Mass or continuity claim from the historical Cologne use.
stages.reception: Binding status is documented for the archdiocese by 2026; first-use date not established.

stages.label: Speyer Mass and lectionary proper confirmation
stages.date_label: 11 July 1975 confirmation after 1971 calendar approval and 1972 confirmation
stages.scope: Particular calendar and proper texts for the first edition of Speyer's Missal and Lectionary adjuncts, as reported in a later official book.
stages.witness_label: Approval references on p.2 of the Diocese of Speyer's 2023 Lectionary
stages.summary: The 2023 book reports Bishop Wetter's calendar approval on 3 November 1971, Roman confirmation on 15 November 1972 (2069/71) and Roman confirmation of Mass/Lectionary proper texts on 11 July 1975 (697/75).

evidence.locus: PDF p.2, Approbation und Konfirmation, lines 5–14
evidence.claim: Official book gives the three dated and scoped approvals and protocol references.

stages.limitations: These are retrospective references, not inspected original approval instruments or the first proper texts. No exact before/after change or first celebration is claimed.
stages.reception: Approval is attested; actual use of the first edition is not independently dated.

stages.label: Speyer second expanded proper Missal and first Lectionary edition
stages.scope: Contemporary proper Mass-book and Lectionary components, with identified feast dates and ranks.
stages.witness_label: 2023 Speyer Lectionary PDF and official page identifying the companion Missal
stages.summary: The official page identifies a second expanded Missal edition and first Lectionary edition in 2023; the Lectionary's title and contents identify the local feast set and rank distinctions.

evidence.locus: Eigenfeiern page, Mass-book and Lectionary listing
evidence.claim: The diocese lists the 2023 paired editions.
The Lectionary title, authority references and feast contents are directly checked.

stages.limitations: The companion second expanded Missal body and first edition are not collated; 2023 is not inferred to be a new approval event or a proved substantive revision.
stages.reception: Official diocesan operative-book listing is checked; precise local first-use date is unestablished.

gaps.missing: Original papal permission and 1605/1642 book text, including the exact Salzburg local formularies and their earlier equivalents.
gaps.next_source: Salzburg archdiocesan archive 1596 Ordo Romanus and 1605 missal; BSB digital bsb11057620; Austrian National Library copy of 1642 proper booklet.
gaps.consequence: No act station for the 1596 permission or verified 1605-to-1642 text transition.

gaps.missing: Original 1632 decree image text; before/after Roman and local rubrics, saints' formularies; 1784 supplement pages and application.
gaps.next_source: ULB Münster 51 FOL 13-1_2, image 11 and original Mass sections; diocesan archive DS 1915 pp.603–630 and copies without supplement.
gaps.consequence: The book and supplement are bounded, but no substantive revision link or universal-use claim is demonstrated.

gaps.missing: Original Speyer 1971, 1972 and 1975 instruments, first proper book, 2023 second Missal body, and prayer/reading collation.
gaps.next_source: Speyer Prot. 2069/71 and 697/75, first edition Eigenfeiern and second expanded 2023 Missal.
gaps.consequence: Approval and operative regional component states are distinguishable, but exact edition deltas and initial local reception remain unresolved.

gaps.missing: The original diocesan approval instruments, precise scope of each Swiss diocesan proper, later editions and first dated local use have not been collated.
gaps.next_source: Original 1976 Eigenmessen and Eigenlesungen volumes and approval pages for Basel, Chur, St Gallen, Sion and Lausanne–Geneva–Fribourg; later diocesan directories and book editions.
gaps.consequence: The attested regional adjunct does not establish a complete Swiss missal or uniform reception across the named dioceses.

gaps.missing: The 2002 Cologne proper's original approval pages, complete text, first dated use and later edition changes have not been collated.
gaps.next_source: Original 2002 Proprium des Erzbistums Köln volume and decrees; annual Cologne Directorium statements for use and later changes.
gaps.consequence: The binding adjunct status does not establish a separate whole missal or descent from an older Cologne use.
